issues.issue: P1 cliplist: the left rail is eight icon-only buttons (home, grid, folder, calendar, bar chart, link, crown, gear) with no labels, and the crown and link glyphs cannot be identified from the screen.
P1 cliplist: the only filled white button on the screen is 'Add more credits' in the header, while each clip's actual actions are three unlabeled icons (calendar, download, scissors) under its score.
P1 editor: five settings share one ~11px header run in three formats ('9:16', 'Layout: Fill', a bare 'B', 'Color correction: OFF'), so none of them reads as a control.

P2 cliplist: 'Keep / Maybe / Skip' is 11px gray text at the bottom of each row, the quietest element on the list that exists to collect that decision, and a kept clip is marked only by the focus ring on row 02's 'Keep'.
P2 cliplist: the centre pane shows a still frame with no play, scrub or volume control, so the clip under review cannot be watched from this screen.
P2 editor: the outlined 'Download MP4' button sits one row above the black 'Apply changes' in the same right-aligned column, so export and commit read as the same kind of decision.
P3 cliplist: the Created column mixes three formats in one column, 'March 6' (row 1), 'Tuesday' (row 2) and 'April 9' (row 5).

P3 editor: disabled AI tools ('Eye Contact', 'Green screen', 'Automatic multicam', 'Blur speaker background') sit at roughly 2:1 on white with no reason given, and enabled rows in the same list use the same weight.
P3 editor: the right rail lists AI Tools, Project, Properties, Elements, Captions, Stock and Underlord with one identical treatment, so panel switches and one-shot tools look the same.

P4 cliplist: rows 4 to 10 (ENG-811, ENG-810, ENG-786, ENG-784, ENG-722, ENG-788) are prefixed with literal '---' characters as an indent, which reads as stray text rather than a parent/child relationship.
P4 cliplist: the list header offers only 'Filter' and 'Display' plus a search icon; there is no create-issue control anywhere on the screen.
P4 editor: the same title is printed twice within about 90px, as 'IOS-30 Fix memory leak in map view controller' in the tab strip and as 'Fix memory leak in map view controller' in the page heading.

P5 cliplist: three raw identifiers (d591db2c-0a82-482e-a8c8-5f93768b9a24, 69e48d8e849ab9426f17022d, composer-5gohk1e06) are printed as body text above the 'Tracks' heading, where the section header belongs.
P5 cliplist: '+ Create' (purple, filled) and 'Ask Co-Creator' (outlined) sit side by side at the same size and weight in the header, so the page has two primaries.
P5 editor: the active 'Sound Effects' tab carries both a 3px rounded focus ring and a 2px underline, a doubled indicator, and the field below it still reads 'Search music'.
P6 cliplist: the project meta under each thumbnail ('215.4K | 00:03', '2.6M | 00:07') is set around 10px in mid-gray, the smallest type on a screen whose job is choosing a project.
P6 cliplist: an 'AI' badge sits on all three top tiles and all seven 'More tools' tiles, so it distinguishes nothing, and a cyan dot floats above the 'Project sync' button attached to no element.

P6 editor: in the Details panel the 'Saved' value is a full path (C:/Users/Admin/Desktop/CapCut Drafts/1025 (1)) that wraps to two lines while every other value stays on one, breaking the label/value column.

notes: Only P2 shows a screen for the error state (a staged run with the failing step, its exit code and two captioned ways forward); the other five are scored on the screens they have, and their empty/error scores reflect that absence. P3 and P4 show a generic project list and an issue tracker rather than a set of clips to review, so those categories judge the screens actually filed under each code.
